attchmntText: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited submitted an Analysts Presentation to BSE and NSE on 16th November 2026. The company details the acquisition of MicroBiopharm Japan for INR 1,351 Cr, funded via QIP and NCDs. MBJ reported FY26 revenue of INR 557 Cr. GTBL is transitioning from a fermentation-based API manufacturer to a CDMO. The Vapi facility capacity has expanded to 990 KL. A hybrid renewable power project with 18.45 MW capacity is under commissioning. Consolidated financials for H1 FY27 show revenue of INR 93.7 Cr and a PAT loss of INR 2.8 Cr. The loss is attributed to one-time foreign exchange losses of INR 15.57 Cr, partial-period consolidation of MBJ, and earthquake-related expenses of INR 1.2 Cr.

attchmntText: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for un-audited financial results (standalone and consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published on Sunday, 15th November, 2026, in Western Times in English and Gujarati languages. The filings were made pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The advertisements include a QR code and a weblink to access the complete financial results. The information is also available on the company website at www.gtbl.in.

attchmntText: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 47.5 crore, up 12% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs. 17.7 crore, down 15.3% year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs. 8.5 crore, down 40.6% year-on-year. H1 FY27 standalone revenue stood at Rs. 91.2 crore, up 16.7% year-on-year. H1 EBITDA was Rs. 38.5 crore, up 10.5% year-on-year. H1 profit after tax was Rs. 19.5 crore, down 16.3% year-on-year. Consolidated results were impacted by foreign exchange losses of Rs. 15.57 crore and one-off expenses of Rs. 1.2 crore. The company acquired MicroBiopharm Japan for JPY 21.5 billion. It also agreed to acquire a portfolio from Sanofi for approximately EUR 158 million. The new fermentation facility was commissioned, impacting near-term margins.

attchmntText: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of  Mr. Vineet Ganesh Gawankar as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. November 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited intimates the resignation of Mr. Vineet Gawankar from the positions of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The resignation is effective from the close of business hours on November 30, 2026. Mr. Gawankar has tendered his resignation to pursue opportunities outside the organization. The company has submitted the relevant details and a copy of the resignation letter to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. Dr. Dinesh Patel, Chairperson and Director, signed the intimation on November 14, 2026.

voiceSummary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited filed a statement regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Qualified Institutions Placement for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company raised Rs. 750,00,00,000 through the issuance of 21,186,440 equity shares at Rs. 354 per share on August 28, 2026. The company confirmed there is no deviation or variation in the use of funds. Funds are being utilized towards the original objects, including supporting inorganic growth opportunities and general corporate purposes. India Ratings & Research Private Limited, the monitoring agency, reported no deviation from the objects. The audit committee noted no deviation in the use of proceeds. Unutilized amounts are being held in escrow or bank accounts and will be utilized within the approved timeline.

attchmntText: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited approved unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a net loss of 277.66 lakh INR, compared to a net profit of 2,332.56 lakh INR in the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 9,371.07 lakh INR. The board noted the resignation of Mr. Vineet Gawankar as Company Secretary effective 30th November 2026. During the quarter, the company allotted 2.11 crore shares at Rs. 354 per share, raising 750 crore INR via Qualified Institutions Placement. It also issued 58,500 Non-Convertible Debentures aggregating 585 crore INR. The group acquired 100% of MicroBiopharm Japan Co. Ltd. for JPY 2.12 crore, recognizing provisional goodwill of Rs. 1061.45 crore. Exceptional items include a loss from an earthquake in the subsidiary.
